text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black oversized double-breasted suit with wide trousers, white shirt, black shoes.
original_prompt: Precise product image edit. Remove black necktie and both black gloves/hands from sleeves and pockets. Empty sleeves. Keep black suit, white shirt and shoes. Preserve all unmentioned details. Pure white background, soft studio light, fully uncropped portrait 2:3 1024x1536. No person, body, skin, mannequin, stand, reference inset, labels or watermark.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
